svg.title: BlaBla architecture
svg.desc: The CLI and project layer compose two independent verification pipelines: behavior parsing and typed IR feed a finite campaign through the trusted application adapter; structure parsing feeds static source providers and one fact evaluator. finish combines fresh canonical behavior and live structure into OVERALL. Alongside them, memory feeds queries, task records feed deterministic challenge, and explicit host checkpoints feed bounded expert policy and optional advice. These non-gating surfaces never decide completion.
